settings.question: 1. What makes Athloun bamboo polo shirts different from regular polo shirts?
settings.answer: Athloun's bamboo polo shirts are made from a premium bamboo-cotton-elastane blend that delivers performance on two levels. First, bamboo fibre offers natural inherent benefits — antimicrobial and anti-odor properties, UPF 50+ sun protection, superior breathability, and moisture-wicking technology. Second, select styles are enhanced with performance finishes achieved through plant-based chemistry: our Travel Polo and Luxe Vee carry a stain-repellent and wrinkle-free finish (Zelan R3 — plant-based technology that repels wine, tea, coffee, and ketchup), while our EcoEMO range is infused with neem and tulsi extracts through a patented herbal finish (Patent IN 318405). No synthetic chemicals. No virgin polyester. Just plant-powered performance.

settings.question: 2. Are Athloun polo shirts suitable for both work and weekend wear?
settings.answer: Yes! Our polo shirts are designed as versatile athleisure clothing that transitions seamlessly from office to outdoor activities. The tailored collar and clean silhouette give you a professional look for work, while the breathable bamboo fabric makes them perfect for golf, recreational tennis, pickleball, travel, and leisure activities.

settings.question: 3. How does the anti-odor technology in bamboo polo shirts work?
settings.answer: Bamboo fibre is naturally antibacterial, which prevents the growth of odor-causing bacteria. This means your Athloun polo stays fresh longer, even after active outings or long days. The plant-based fabric achieves these anti-odor benefits without chemical treatments.

settings.question: 4. What is UPF 50+ protection and why is it important in polo shirts?
settings.answer: UPF 50+ (Ultraviolet Protection Factor) blocks over 98% of harmful UV rays from reaching your skin. This makes our polo shirts ideal for outdoor activities like golf, pickleball, or travel. Unlike regular cotton shirts that offer minimal sun protection, Athloun's bamboo blend provides built-in sun safety.

settings.question: 5. Are Athloun polo shirts good for summer and hot weather?
settings.answer: Absolutely! The lightweight bamboo fabric is naturally breathable and moisture-wicking, making it perfect for summer wear. The soft, airy texture allows excellent air circulation, keeping you cool and comfortable even in hot, humid conditions.

settings.question: 6. How do I care for my bamboo polo shirt to maintain its quality?
settings.answer: Our bamboo polo shirts are machine washable. For best results, refer to the care label on your garment for specific washing and drying instructions. The bamboo fabric is naturally durable and maintains its softness, breathability, and anti-odor properties over time.

settings.question: 7. What sizes are available for Athloun premium polo shirts?
settings.answer: We offer sizes from Small (S) to Double Extra Large (2XL) in most styles. Our polo shirts feature a tailored fit and are designed to look great both tucked and untucked.

settings.question: 8. Is Athloun an eco-friendly and sustainable athleisure brand?
settings.answer: Yes, Athloun is committed to sustainable and ethical fashion. We use plant-based bamboo fabric — a rapidly renewable resource that requires less water and fewer chemicals than conventional cotton. Our manufacturing partners operate under independently audited standards for fair wages, safe workspaces, and responsible production. We use no virgin polyester and no harmful chemicals in any of our products.

settings.question: 9. What activities are Athloun polo shirts best suited for?
settings.answer: Our polo shirts are designed for active lifestyles and work perfectly for golf, pickleball, yoga, recreational tennis, office wear, travel, casual outings, and daily wear. The moisture-wicking and breathable properties make them ideal for low-to-medium intensity activities where comfort and style matter.

settings.question: 10. Do Athloun polo shirts have stain-repellent properties?
settings.answer: Select styles in our Travel Polo collection feature plant-based stain-repellent and wrinkle-free technology that repels water-based stains like wine, tea, coffee, and ketchup. These are perfect for business travel and busy lifestyles.

settings.question: 11. What is the price range for Athloun bamboo polo shirts in India?
settings.answer: Our polo shirts are priced at ₹1,999 for the Pure Play Polo collection and ₹2,499 for premium Travel Polo styles with stain-repellent technology. All prices are inclusive of taxes, and we offer 10% off on first orders with code WELCOME10.

settings.question: 12. How does bamboo fabric feel compared to cotton polo shirts?
settings.answer: Bamboo fabric feels softer and silkier than regular cotton, with a luxurious texture that gets even softer with each wash. It's lighter weight than cotton but more durable, and naturally has a subtle sheen that gives it a premium appearance.

settings.question: 13. Do bamboo polo shirts shrink?
settings.answer: Plant-based fibres like bamboo, cotton, and modal may show a natural shrinkage of up to 5% after the first wash. This is a normal characteristic of natural fabrics and stabilises after the initial laundering. Following the care instructions on your garment label will help minimise this.

settings.question: 14. What is Athloun's EcoEMO technology?
settings.answer: EcoEMO is Athloun's patented plant-based fabric technology (Patent IN 318405), infused with 100% natural neem and tulsi extracts. This herbal finish gives the fabric natural antimicrobial, anti-odor, and bug-repellent properties, plus additional UV resistance (lab-tested to a minimum UPF 20 per AATCC183 standards) — durable for 30+ washes. EcoEMO products are made from cotton and modal, are 100% vegan, and free from synthetic chemical treatments. Lab tested and confirmed per AATCC100 and AATCC183 standards.

settings.question: 15. Are Athloun polo shirts vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. All Athloun products are 100% vegan. We use no animal-derived fibres, dyes, or finishes in any of our products. Our fabrics — bamboo, modal, organic cotton, and herbal-finished cotton — are entirely plant-based and cruelty-free.

settings.question: 16. Is Athloun an Indian brand?
settings.answer: Yes. Athloun is a proudly Indian brand — Athloun Product Lab Pvt. Ltd. is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka. We are a fabric-first, sustainability-focused men's athleisure brand built for the modern Indian professional.

settings.question: 17. How long does Athloun delivery take?
settings.answer: We deliver across India within 3–7 business days. For order-related queries, contact us at [support@athloun.com](mailto:support@athloun.com) or call +91 81232 46999.
